Naruto is a Japanese manga series by Masashi Kishimoto about Naruto Uzumaki, a young ninja seeking recognition and dreaming of becoming the leader (Hokage) of his village. The story follows his journey in two parts, from pre-teen to teenage years, chronicling his growth, friendships, and battles. The manga ran from 1999 to 2014, concluding with 72 volumes and 700 chapters, and spawned a highly successful anime adaptation and other media.
